A '''thermal tent''' was a type of tent with insulated lining that could keep out cold temperature.<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>

While looking for [[Mandalore's Mask]] on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Canderous Ordo]] shared a single thermal tent between them.<ref name="Revan" />
